context: An office worker guides a barista friend through publishing online
purpose: Teach: ペーパー/ポリシー/フレーム/ドライバー/転載/改行/文字数/全角

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: ブログ始めるんでしょ？まず投稿のフレームを決めとくと楽だよ。
lines.en: Starting a blog, right? Decide your post frame first—it makes life easier.
lines.style: Friendly office-worker tone, casual encouraging advice between friends

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: ありがとう。実はペーパー日記みたいなのは書いてたんだけど、ネットは初めてで。
lines.en: Thanks. I've kept a paper journal, but posting online is totally new to me.
lines.style: Hesitant barista voice, soft and slightly nervous about new territory

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: まずプライバシーポリシーのページを作ろう。コーヒー豆の仕入れ先とかは載せちゃダメだよ。
lines.en: Start with a privacy policy page. Don't post things like bean suppliers publicly.
lines.style: Practical advice tone, gently warning about online disclosure pitfalls

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: なるほど。あと他のカフェの記事を勝手に転載するのもまずいよね？
lines.en: I see. And reposting other cafes' articles without permission is also bad, right?
lines.style: Curious learner tone, checking understanding with a thoughtful question

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: うん、無断はアウト。あと意外と大事なのが文字数と改行のバランスね。
lines.en: Yeah, unauthorized is out. Character count and line breaks matter more than you think.
lines.style: Confident mentor tone, sharing practical tips about online readability

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 改行少ないと読みにくいよね。スマホだと特に。
lines.en: Fewer line breaks really hurt readability, especially on smartphones I've noticed.
lines.style: Engaged barista reflecting on her own reading habits and experiences

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: そうそう。あと全角の英数字混ぜると見栄え悪いから、半角で統一して。
lines.en: Exactly. Mixing full-width letters looks messy, so stick to half-width throughout.
lines.style: Detail-oriented office worker giving precise formatting guidance kindly

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 細かいなあ。でも私のサイト、まだ画像アップロードのドライバーが上手く動かなくて。
lines.en: So detailed! But my site's image upload driver isn't even working properly yet.
lines.style: Slightly overwhelmed laugh, admitting technical struggles with humor

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: あはは、それは後で一緒に直そう。とりあえず週一更新のポリシーで気楽にやりなよ。
lines.en: Haha, we'll fix that together later. Start with a weekly-post policy and relax.
lines.style: Warm closing reassurance, supportive friend wrapping up the lesson gently
